title: Tree chart
description: Hierarchies drawn as tidy trees, radial trees, mind maps and org charts: organizations, file systems, taxonomies, plans. The tidy tree (Buchheim / Reingold–Tilford) never overlaps and centers every parent over its children; subtrees collapse and expand with an animation, from a click, the keyboard or the API.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: TreeChart takes nodes and parent → child edges; nodes without a parent are roots (tree.root picks one). Edges that would create a cycle or a second parent are ignored.
overview.tidy: The tidy tree runs in linear time and takes the size of every node into account: labels never overlap, parents are centered over their children and identical subtrees look the same.
overview.layouts: layout="tree" (left to right by default, any direction), "radial" (rings around the root, labels along the radius), "mindmap" (branches balanced on both sides, colored per branch) and "org" (cards with a title and a subtitle, orthogonal connectors, leaf teams stacked in columns).
overview.collapse: Click a node with children, press Enter on it, or call expand / collapse / toggle: its subtree folds into it with an animation and a badge counts the hidden nodes. collapsed on a node starts it folded.

props.name: layout
props.description: Kind of tree: tidy tree, radial tree, two-sided mind map or org chart

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction of `layout="tree"`

props.name: tree
props.description: Root, spacing, collapsing, card size

props.name: nodes
props.description: The nodes

props.name: edges
props.description: The edges (parent → child in trees, prerequisite → dependent in DAGs)

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups: legend order, names and colors

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: nodeShape
props.description: Shape of the nodes without `shape` (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)

props.name: nodeSize
props.description: Circle diameter in layout units, or `[min, max]` scaled by the node `value`

props.name: edgeStyle
props.description: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted

props.name: edgeWidth
props.description: Edge width in CSS pixels, or `[min, max]` scaled by the edge `value`

props.name: edgeColor
props.description: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads on the edges without `directed`

props.name: arrowStyle
props.description: Shape of the arrowheads: `open` (a slim outlined head) or `filled` (a solid head in the edge color, which follows the theme and the highlight)

props.name: nodeLabels
props.description: Node labels; `auto` hides minor and overlapping labels when zoomed out. Text inside boxes keeps a readable minimum size and is shortened with an ellipsis; it is hidden only when the box is too small for any text, or with `false`

props.name: edgeLabels
props.description: Edge labels: always, `auto` (zoomed in or highlighted), only `hover`, or never

props.name: highlight
props.description: What hovering / selecting a node highlights

props.name: selected
props.description: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection)

props.name: animation
props.description: Animates layout and data changes; a number is the duration in ms

props.name: fitPadding
props.description: Padding around the graph when fitting it, in CSS pixels

props.name: controls
props.description: Zoom buttons (zoom in, zoom out, fit)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend of the groups; shown by default with several groups

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: interaction
props.description: Drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, nodes can be dragged (force, circular), click selects, arrow keys move between nodes; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the nodes and edges: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software

props.name: palette
props.description: Group colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changes

events.name: onItemClick
events.description: Called when a node or an edge is clicked (or a node activated with Enter)

events.name: onSelectionChange
events.description: Called with the ids of the selected nodes when the selection changes

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a tree node is collapsed or expanded

events.name: onGroupToggle
events.description: Called when the legend shows / hides a group

events.name: onLayoutEnd
events.description: Called when the layout is done (the force simulation cooled down)

events.name: onRendererChange
events.description: Called with the backend once it is ready (and after a fallback)

examples.title: Tournament bracket
examples.description: A knockout bracket from right to left (direction="RL") with box nodes and orthogonal edges: the final is the root and the teams are the leaves, named with Intl.DisplayNames. Next round reveals results simulated with a seeded generator, and the groups color the teams still in, the eliminated ones and the champion.

examples.title: Decision tree
examples.description: A loan approval policy as an org layout with labeled branches (edgeLabels). Answer the questions with the radio buttons: the reached outcome is passed as selected and highlight="lineage" lights up the path from the root; tree.collapsible is off so clicks do not fold the questions.

examples.title: Disk usage
examples.description: A file system where each node value is the size of the folder, so nodeSize as [min, max] scales the circles with the bytes. Sizes are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat units, the radio buttons switch between the tree and radial layouts, and a click reads the share of the parent folder and of the disk.

examples.title: Collapsible file tree
examples.description: A project tree from left to right, colored by file type. Deep folders start collapsed; click a folder to open it, or use the buttons, which call expand(), collapse() and fit() on the ref.

examples.title: Mind map
examples.description: A launch plan around its central topic. The branches are balanced between the two sides by their number of ideas, every branch gets a color, and the lines get thinner away from the center.

examples.title: Org chart
examples.description: Cards with the name and the job title, colored by department, connected by orthogonal lines; teams without reports are stacked in columns to keep the chart narrow. The backend team starts collapsed: click a manager to fold or unfold the team.

examples.title: Radial tree
examples.description: The components of a design system around the library name, with the labels along the radius. The radius grows with the number of leaves so the labels never overlap.

examples.title: Category search
examples.description: The category taxonomy of a store, with the second level collapsed. Type to select every matching category; Enter or a tag calls focusNode() on the ref, which expands the collapsed ancestors before centering the node, and the breadcrumb of the category is shown below.

examples.title: Work breakdown structure
examples.description: The plan of a mobile app release: work packages carry story points and a status, and summary items roll the points and the progress up in their subtitles. The detail level calls expand() and collapse() on the ref, and onToggle reports the points of the folded or unfolded item.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.nodes: Nodes { id, label, group, value… }; property only
props.edges: Edges { source, target, value, label… }; property only
props.groups: Groups { id, name, color }: legend order, names and colors; property only
props.nodeShape: Shape of the nodes without shape (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)
props.edgeStyle: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted
props.edgeColor: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node
props.arrowStyle: Shape of the arrowheads: open (a slim outlined head) or filled (a solid head in the edge color, following the theme and the highlight)
props.highlight: What hovering / selecting a node highlights
props.locale: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); the page language by default
props.selected: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection); property only
props.options: Other engine options (GraphChartOptions: force, circular, dag, tree, nodeSize, edgeWidth, arrows, nodeLabels, edgeLabels, animation, legend, tooltip, interaction, renderer, palette, ariaLabel, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changed; detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-item-click: A node or an edge was clicked (or a node activated with Enter); detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }
events.minerva-toggle: A tree node was collapsed or expanded; detail: { id, collapsed }
events.minerva-group-toggle: The legend showed / hid a group; detail: { group, hidden }
events.minerva-layout-end: The layout is done (the force simulation cooled down); detail: { layout }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.fit: Fits the visible nodes in the view
methods.focusNode: Centers a node (expanding its collapsed ancestors), optionally zooming
methods.setData: Replaces the data until the properties change again
methods.expand: Expands a node (all nodes without an id)
methods.collapse: Collapses a node (all nodes with children without an id)
methods.getPositions: Current positions of the nodes in layout units
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
